fields.name: demonstrated_method
fields.description: Record the demonstrated cube-moving method at the first decision step and retain it unchanged throughout the episode. Values are "lift", "hook", or "push". Use "lift" when the demonstration grasps and raises the cube before transporting and placing it; "hook" when it grasps and raises the peg and then uses that tool to move the cube; "push" when the closed gripper moves the cube along the surface without lifting it. Classify by the motion over time, not isolated held-object labels. Episode 30 has "lift" at both steps; episodes 38 and 56 have "hook" at both steps; episodes 83 and 96 have "push" at their sole steps. e.g. "hook"
